relationship_note: The relationship arrays below are capability-level summary codes, not positional mappings to the secondary string. Use component-relationships.csv for explicit component-by-component classifications covering the full decision inventory.

capabilities.primary_owner: native Codex plus owner/repository instructions
capabilities.finding: Guardrails added no measured outcome gain; Superpowers brainstorming adds approval gates and conflicts with proceed-when-specified instructions.

capabilities.primary_owner: global continuous-autonomous-completion agreement plus native Codex
capabilities.finding: Continue routine safe work and ask only for material tradeoffs, authority, or ambiguity; this owner policy was added after trials and is not credited with causal benchmark lift.

capabilities.primary_owner: native Codex
capabilities.secondary: Codex Security formal artifacts on explicit request (uncertain specialized value)
capabilities.finding: Superpowers brainstorming is redundant for routine changes; Security threat-model artifacts are distinct but did not improve the one same-prompt outcome.

capabilities.primary_owner: repository execution plan for complex work; native lightweight plan otherwise
capabilities.finding: Generic plan systems duplicated the durable plan and forced small-step artifacts or execution gates.

capabilities.primary_owner: native Codex
capabilities.secondary: Coordinator uncertain/conditional; Engineering Guardrails and Superpowers removed
capabilities.finding: Native and Coordinator both completed Tasks C and H correctly after prompt-aligned adjudication; Coordinator added overhead on C but was faster on one H run, while Superpowers bite-sized task graphs timed out.

capabilities.primary_owner: native subagents and processes
capabilities.finding: Parallelize only independent read/write surfaces; Coordinator may add bounded ownership for substantial work but should not force agent count.

capabilities.primary_owner: native parent/child tasks with one integrating parent
capabilities.finding: Coordinator's active board remains unmeasured, but its default-off Task H treatment complemented native execution; Superpowers' per-task graph, ledger, and repeated reviews prevented terminal delivery.

capabilities.primary_owner: native Git worktree commands plus repository isolation rule
capabilities.finding: Superpowers adds no necessary primitive and conflicts with Coordinator if invoked after shared-checkout claims begin.

capabilities.primary_owner: native Codex
capabilities.secondary: Coordinator uncertain/conditional; Engineering Guardrails and Superpowers removed
capabilities.finding: Native and Coordinator delivered correct terminal Task H implementations; Guardrails and Superpowers produced correct workspaces but failed to return.

capabilities.primary_owner: native Codex using repository tests
capabilities.finding: Use a failing regression when practical; absolute methodology added disproportionate repetition.

capabilities.primary_owner: native Codex
capabilities.finding: Both debugging methodologies overlapped native root-cause work and increased cost.

capabilities.primary_owner: repository-declared exact checks
capabilities.finding: Task H showed the core collision directly: Guardrails ran 13 observed test commands and Superpowers layered task plus broad reviews, yet neither returned within 1200 seconds; one proportional authoritative verification owner is required.

capabilities.primary_owner: native review capability
capabilities.secondary: GitHub connector only for explicit remote thread context
capabilities.finding: Use one independent review only when risk warrants it; generic review skills are removed.

capabilities.primary_owner: native Codex for ordinary security-sensitive changes
capabilities.secondary: Codex Security formal scan/tool pipeline when canonical artifacts are explicitly required
capabilities.finding: The formal pipeline's scan, finding, and attack-path artifacts are distinct, but one same-prompt trial showed no correctness lift and large cost.

capabilities.primary_owner: native Codex unless a persisted formal model is requested
capabilities.secondary: Codex Security formal pipeline (uncertain specialized value)
capabilities.finding: Formal threat-model artifacts are unique; outcome improvement was not demonstrated.

capabilities.primary_owner: native Codex for ordinary validation and remediation
capabilities.secondary: Codex Security formal pipeline for canonical validation/attack-path artifacts
capabilities.finding: Security's artifact lifecycle is distinct; native produced the same required portable fix at much lower cost in Task I.

capabilities.primary_owner: native PTY execution and polling to terminal
capabilities.finding: Removed Process Jobs uniquely supplied a cross-client job registry, but harmed ordinary terminal tasks by releasing the turn.

capabilities.primary_owner: native browser/web surfaces when available
capabilities.finding: Browser Recorder is not installed; Record and Replay is unavailable on Linux; web-perf lacks its Chrome DevTools MCP dependency.

capabilities.primary_owner: native browser/source editing for ordinary work
capabilities.secondary: Visual Truth only for explicit compatible React WYSIWYG tasks
capabilities.finding: Visual Truth was installed after controlled trials; its editor bridge is distinct but outcome value remains unmeasured and it is excluded from the empirical minimal stack.

capabilities.primary_owner: native git and gh under repository rules
capabilities.secondary: GitHub connector for structured remote context
capabilities.finding: Ordinary mechanics are duplicated by GitHub workflow skills; connector value is unmeasured because the skill-only condition disabled apps.

capabilities.primary_owner: Git commits, repository execution plan, state/CURRENT-STATE.md, and PR
capabilities.finding: Superpowers SDD progress files and review packages form a competing ledger.

capabilities.primary_owner: Git and repository state
capabilities.finding: Coordinator state is bounded to active ownership; no second progress diary should mirror it.

capabilities.primary_owner: native shell with exact repository commands
capabilities.finding: Connector assumptions in two GitHub skills are stale relative to the current tool schema.

capabilities.primary_owner: native Git and gh under explicit owner authority
capabilities.secondary: GitHub yeet only for an explicit publish request
capabilities.finding: Superpowers finish-the-branch menu conflicts with standing local-merge authority and established publish rules.

capabilities.primary_owner: Git plus repository plan/state and benchmark schedule ledger
capabilities.finding: A supervisor crash preserved and relocated one interrupted Task H attempt without rerunning three terminal trials; native and Coordinator both satisfy the prompt-aligned incomplete-evidence contract, while Superpowers added a competing ledger.

capabilities.primary_owner: Plugin Management
capabilities.finding: Permissions, dependencies, and removal are unique but irrelevant to ordinary coding.

capabilities.primary_owner: specialized apps only on explicit domain tasks
capabilities.finding: Nansen, SciSpace, and Wolfram are specialized; Exa and Parallels duplicate native retrieval.
